The checks corroborate rather than replace the proof.

value.rationale: Question 40 in the recent survey asks for exact minimum dimensions for prescribed finite automorphism groups. The theorem completely computes this natural invariant and its perfect analogue for the first odd cyclic group over ALL fields, with a genuinely arithmetic phase diagram (algebraically closed K needs dimension three, many finite fields dimension two, F4 only needs dimension one). Explicit sharp constructions and nonperfect exclusion make this a structural result, not a table lookup or arbitrary parameter slice.
